Precision means not flagging things that merely resemble sensitive data.
Every value below has a weak, PII-ish shape but is something mundane, and
with no context keyword to vouch for it, the pipeline must leave it alone.
(Strong self-identifying shapes like emails or IPv4 addresses are excluded
here — they fire on their own by design and belong in dense_patterns.txt.)

The bracket 000123456789 identifies the replacement part in the catalog.
Batch 000987654321 shipped from the east warehouse on Tuesday.
Aisle 000555 holds the seasonal overstock near the loading dock.
The discontinued variant is unit 000456000456 in the parts list.

These are catalog numbers, batch ids, aisle labels, and part codes — weak
shapes with no card, account, or ID keyword nearby, so a precise pipeline
redacts none of them.
